description: This Java class 'DelinquencyRangeParseAndValidator' is responsible for parsing and validating JSON input related to delinquency range data in the Fineract project. It extends a generic parser and validator, utilizing helper classes to extract and validate JSON parameters, and produces a DelinquencyRangeData object if validation passes.
